name: GhostDatePicker
description: Headless date-entry and selection root: strict ISO typed entry for a single date or inclusive range, an anchored modal calendar (APG Date Picker Dialog), separate drafts and committed CalendarDate values, native form serialization, validation, and reset.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled value and uncontrolled form-reset target.

props.name: defaultVisibleMonth
props.description: Month shown when the picker opens empty.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks all interaction and closes the calendar.

props.name: form
props.description: External `<form>` id for submission, validation, and reset.

props.name: format
props.description: Synchronous display formatter; defaults to ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`.

props.name: formatHint
props.description: Format description linked to every input.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Controlled committed value; `undefined` is uncontrolled, `null` is controlled empty.

props.name: parse
props.description: Synchronous parser; defaults to strict ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps text focusable and selectable but prevents editing, clearing, and opening.

props.name: required
props.description: Native required constraint on an empty committed value.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: `'single'` or `'range'`; fixed for the instance (remount with a new `key`).

props.name: today
props.description: Explicit current date for SSR-safe "today" styling and focus fallback.

props.name: validateRange
props.description: Whole-range business validation returning an error message or `null`.

parts.name: input
parts.description: Native text input from GhostDatePickerInput (data-input-part single/start/end).

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: Native button from GhostDatePickerTrigger that opens the calendar dialog.

parts.name: content
parts.description: Positioned modal dialog surface from GhostDatePickerContent.

parts.name: close
parts.description: Built-in Close control inside the content.

parts.name: error-summary
parts.description: Focusable in-dialog error summary shown after an invalid event while open.

parts.name: status
parts.description: Polite status line for the range instruction and calendar validation feedback.

parts.name: format-hint
parts.description: Visually hidden format description linked to every input.

parts.name: error-description
parts.description: Visually hidden per-input error text linked while errors are shown.

states.name: open
states.description: Trigger data-state while the calendar dialog is open.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Input data-state when it has errors or the consumer marked it invalid.

keyboard.Enter: In an edited input, commits the text and prevents implicit form submission. On the trigger, opens the calendar. On a date, selects it.
keyboard.Space: On the trigger, opens the calendar. On a date, selects it.
keyboard.Escape: In the open dialog, closes it without committing calendar progress and restores focus. In an edited closed input, restores the committed text.
keyboard.Tab: Cycles through the dialog controls; the grid is a single Tab stop.
keyboard.Shift+Tab: Cycles backward through the dialog controls.
